title: pgAssistant - Executive Plan - Fleet Overview
description: Fleet-wide Executive Plan priorities, ownership and collection health.

list.name: team
list.label: Team
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT team AS __value, team AS __text FROM pga_executive_plan_task_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND team IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: environment
list.label: Environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(environment, 'unknown') AS __value, coalesce(environment, 'unknown') AS __text FROM pga_collection_run ORDER BY 1

list.name: target_group
list.label: Target group
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(target_group, 'unknown') AS __value, coalesce(target_group, 'unknown') AS __text FROM pga_collection_run ORDER BY 1

list.name: target_id
list.label: Target
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT target_id AS __value, coalesce(target_name, target_id) AS __text FROM pga_collection_run WHERE coalesce(environment, 'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(target_group, 'unknown') IN (${target_group:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 2

list.name: priority
list.label: Priority
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT priority AS __value, priority AS __text FROM pga_executive_plan_task_snapshot WHERE priority IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT p.target_id) FROM pga_executive_plan_snapshot p JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id=p.run_id WHERE $__timeFilter(p.collected_at) AND p.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.target_group,'unknown') IN (${target_group:sqlstring});

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.target_id) p.run_id FROM pga_executive_plan_snapshot p JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id=p.run_id WHERE $__timeFilter(p.collected_at) AND p.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.target_group,'unknown') IN (${target_group:sqlstring}) ORDER BY p.target_id,p.collected_at DESC) SELECT count(*) FROM pga_executive_plan_task_snapshot t JOIN latest l USING(run_id) WHERE t.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND t.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring});

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) run_id FROM pga_executive_plan_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY target_id,collected_at DESC) SELECT count(*) FROM pga_executive_plan_task_snapshot t JOIN latest l USING(run_id) WHERE t.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND t.priority='HIGH';

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) run_id FROM pga_executive_plan_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY target_id,collected_at DESC) SELECT count(*) FROM pga_executive_plan_task_snapshot t JOIN latest l USING(run_id) WHERE t.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND t.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND t.requires_maintenance_window;

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) run_id FROM pga_executive_plan_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY target_id,collected_at DESC) SELECT count(*) FROM pga_executive_plan_task_snapshot t JOIN latest l USING(run_id) WHERE t.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND t.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND t.requires_restart;

SELECT count(*) FROM pga_collection_job_result j JOIN pga_collection_run r USING(run_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(j.created_at) AND j.job_type='executive_plan' AND j.status IN ('failed','partial') AND r.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.target_group,'unknown') IN (${target_group:sqlstring});

panels.title: Current tasks by team and priority

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.target_id) p.run_id FROM pga_executive_plan_snapshot p JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id=p.run_id WHERE $__timeFilter(p.collected_at) AND p.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.target_group,'unknown') IN (${target_group:sqlstring}) ORDER BY p.target_id,p.collected_at DESC) SELECT coalesce(t.team,'UNKNOWN') AS team, count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.priority='HIGH') AS high, count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.priority='MEDIUM') AS medium, count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.priority='LOW') AS low FROM pga_executive_plan_task_snapshot t JOIN latest l USING(run_id) WHERE t.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND t.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT date_trunc('${bucket:raw}',t.collected_at) AS time, coalesce(t.team,'UNKNOWN') AS metric, count(*) AS tasks FROM pga_executive_plan_task_snapshot t JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id=t.run_id WHERE $__timeFilter(t.collected_at) AND t.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) AND t.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND t.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.target_group,'unknown') IN (${target_group:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1;

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.target_id) p.run_id,p.target_id,p.collected_at FROM pga_executive_plan_snapshot p JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id=p.run_id WHERE $__timeFilter(p.collected_at) AND p.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.target_group,'unknown') IN (${target_group:sqlstring}) ORDER BY p.target_id,p.collected_at DESC) SELECT l.target_id, count(*) AS tasks, count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.priority='HIGH') AS high_priority, count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.requires_maintenance_window) AS maintenance_window, count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.requires_restart) AS restart_required, round(max(t.score),1) AS max_score, l.collected_at AS last_collected_at FROM latest l JOIN pga_executive_plan_task_snapshot t USING(run_id) WHERE t.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND t.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring}) GROUP BY l.target_id,l.collected_at ORDER BY high_priority DESC,max_score DESC,tasks DESC LIMIT 100;
